readout_other: Patch-clamp mEPSC/sEPSC; Western blot (GPX4, alpha-synuclein); flow cytometry (iron, lipid peroxidation, Ca2+); electron microscopy; immunofluorescence; ELISA and HPLC dopamine; open field and pole test
direction_notes: US at 610 kHz and 0.2 W/cm2 increased frequency and amplitude of mEPSCs and sEPSCs, restored synaptic vesicle recycling and reduced ferroptosis markers in MPP+ cells and MPTP mice; effects were blocked by the Piezo1 inhibitor GsMTx4.
safety_notes: Behavioral tests were conducted one week after the final injection and again following the treatment. No unexpected adverse events occurred.
